report.summary: Patient P-D002 (46, Medicaid/Lakeshore Community Health Plan with transport benefit) screened positive for a transportation need and had a recent endocrinology no-show. Home tract 17031300900: 15.1% of households lack a vehicle, 53 transit stops within 800 m with early-morning service, and the area is low-income. Found four community transport options; eligibility checked below.

options.name: Medicaid Ride Line (fictional)

options.how_to_access: Apply for ADA paratransit certification by phone; decisions take up to 21 days. May be appropriate if patient has a disability limiting fixed-route transit use.

options.name: RideWell Medical Transport (fictional)
options.how_to_access: Medical transport provider; no eligibility details or phone number provided on the directory page.

options.name: Senior Shuttle West (fictional)
options.how_to_access: Free rides for adults 60+ to medical appointments, weekdays 7 AM–5 PM. Patient is 46, so NOT eligible.
